race.comment: BOLD SUITOR (3) is the horse to beat after being pipped by RISING WATER over 1100m at this track when sent out as an odds-on favourite. He comes back from Saturday company, is second-up, and the Gary Clarke/Jarrod Todd combination gives him a strong platform to convert a near miss. RISING WATER (10) must be respected after beating BOLD SUITOR by a long neck at this track, even if that $20 win asks him to prove he can repeat the level. CHEWING GUM (4) is a five-year-old mare who is having her first run for the Chloe Baxter stable. Hasn't raced since finishing seventh at Geelong five-and-a-half months ago. Not seen at the trials but looks nicely placed. Expected to be in the finish. CAVERN (1) is resuming from a spell and is a winner previously at this track and distance.
